biotools.summary: PhosNetVis is a web-based tool for fast kinase-substrate enrichment analysis and interactive 2D/3D network visualizations of phosphoproteomics datasets. It streamlines phosphoproteomics data analysis steps within a single tool, facilitating user-friendly analysis and visualization.
